# optionledger.flex_section_row r1

optionledger.flex_section_row r1: one revision of one row of a Flex statement section other than trades, attributes as sent without any account attribute, as text; insert only. No account number is stored: the alias is the only identity.

| column | type | nullable | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| alias | string | no | Account alias of the row, the label mapped by the allow-list. |
| section | string | no | Row element name of the section in the Flex statement, for example CashTransaction; a pattern, so a later section needs no schema change. |
| row_key | string | no | Key attributes of the row joined with a bar, as text; an optional attribute that is absent is the empty text. |
| revision | integer | no | Revision of the row for its key; 1 for a new key, a changed row is the next revision. |
| fetch_id | string | no | Identifier of the fetch that first wrote this revision. |
| row_index | integer | no | Position of the row in its section of the report. |
| attributes | string | no | JSON object as text: every attribute of the row as sent, every value text, the account attributes removed. |
| attributes_sha256 | string | no | SHA-256 of the attributes text, 64 lower-case hex digits. |
| recorded_at | string (date-time) | no | Instant the row was recorded, UTC. |

Primary key: (alias, section, row_key, revision)
